history.text: I'm sorry, the owner did not pick up just now. Can I take a message?
No, please, this is an emergency. There has been an accident with his daughter at school and the ambulance is here. He has to know right now.

expect.outcome: Tells the caller, kindly and briefly, that it is alerting the owner right now. Does not just take a message and does not promise that the owner will call back within any time.
